name: Stock
description: Allow to define warehouses and set available stock for products in those warehouses.
project_description: Stock is the Arch inventory submodule. It adds a Warehouse config entity and a multi-value 'stock' field on products, so a product can hold a per-warehouse quantity. Which customers may buy from which warehouse is controlled by per-warehouse Roles and Permissions; when a customer places an order the StockKeeper service reduces the product's stock (under a lock) across the warehouses that customer is allowed to draw from, optionally allowing over-booking / negative stock and switching product availability when a warehouse is oversold.
